study_identification_part.si4_title: A 10-Year Longitudinal Study of Brain Cortical Thickness in People with FirstEpisode Psychosis Using Normative Models

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.answer: Public MRI normative reference datasets and TOP longitudinal psychosis cohort
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Normative reference: pooled public MRI datasets (n≈42,983/40,435 across 77 sites); Study cohort: Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) longitudinal structural MRI with controls and first-episode psychosis (baseline n=218 CTRL, 79 SCZ; follow-ups 197/67 at 12 months, 77/23 at 10 years)
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) from people with first-episode psychosis and controls ( n = 79  and  218)... Normative models for cortical thickness estimated on public MRI datasets ( n = 42 983) were applied to TOP data"

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.answer: Public MRI datasets used to train hierarchical Bayesian normative models; TOP cohort used for adaptation and longitudinal deviation analysis
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference pooled data (40,435 participants) trained HBR models (95% healthy); models adapted to three Oslo scanners using held-out controls, then applied to longitudinal TOP controls and schizophrenia patients to derive deviation scores across timepoints
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Using pooled data from ... 77 sites, and 40 435 participants, the reference normative models were first trained on (95%) healthy individuals and validated on an independent set of 2548 CTRL and patients... We then adapted the model to the 3 unseen Oslo scanners... After this transfer step, we tested the normative models on the remaining longitudinal CTRL and SCZ samples"

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.answer: Reference training ≈38,413 healthy (95% of 40,435); TOP controls 218 at baseline (197 at 12 months; 77 at 10 years)
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Model: HBR normative reference | Phase: train | ~38,413 healthy controls (95% of 40,435 pooled participants); Model: TOP longitudinal application | Phase: overall baseline | 218 CTRL; Phase: 12-month follow-up | 197 CTRL; Phase: 10-year follow-up | 77 CTRL; Model: TOP longitudinal application | Phase: train | NR (adaptation controls not enumerated)
